_note: All values reproduced-from-paper {RfP}; carried from S6/S8/S9 where they were checked against the cited source. Global reference numbers follow S2/S6/S7.

BODMAS_T2_EmberGBDT_F1.protocol: EMBER-trained GBDT, threshold at 0.1% FPR on its own (random 80:20) validation set; monthly BODMAS test sets Oct-2019..Sep-2020; cross-dataset; natural monthly ratio

BODMAS_T3_FPR.protocol: GBDT trained on BODMAS before 2019-10-01, 80:20 split, validation FPR <= 0.1%; monthly test Oct-2019..Sep-2020

BODMAS_T3_unseenFNR_max.protocol: as above, families absent from training (10/2019)

BODMAS_T3_knownFNR_max.protocol: as above, families present in training ('within 6%')

BODMAS_SecV_top23_known.protocol: family classifier, N = 10 families, known families

BODMAS_SecV_top23_all.protocol: N = 10, all test families incl. unseen

EMBER_LGBM_AUC.protocol: EMBER-2017 LightGBM baseline, EMBER-2017 temporal test set, 50:50

EMBER_LGBM_TPR_0.1.protocol: detection rate at < 0.1% FPR (threshold 0.871), as above

EMBER_LGBM_TPR_1.protocol: detection rate at < 1% FPR, as above

D3QN_BODMAS_F1.protocol: RL feature selection (~60 features); published abstract; no temporal split reported

TESSERACT_Android_AUT_F1.protocol: Android, train 2014, test 2015-16 monthly, 24 months; out-of-scope platform, contrast only

Kozak_ATfull_goodware_flips.protocol: EMBER-GBDT hardened by full adversarial retraining; rate computed from reported counts (73/5,983)

Kozak_ATfull_malware_flips.protocol: as above; 27 malware flips (table; the text says 30) over 14,997 malicious test files (1,785 malware + 13,212 adversarial EXEmples), the denominator used in S6; with the 1,785 clean malware alone the rate would be 1.51%: denominator uncertain

Ghiani_regression_Android.protocol: share of malware experiencing security regression after continual-learning updates, Android

RecMaL_family_label_error.protocol: BODMAS family labels shifted or incorrect

EMBER2018_LGBM_AUC.source: EMBER release notebook ember2018-notebook.ipynb (dataset authors' artifact, project doc)
EMBER2018_LGBM_AUC.protocol: published EMBER-2018 LightGBM model, EMBER-2018 test set (Nov-Dec 2018, 200,000 files)
